study.question: Does the dependence between two consecutive elapsed gaps retain useful history information beyond the incumbent event, transition, gap and gap/endpoint-recency summaries? Is any benefit sensitive to chronological direction?
study.hypothesis: The incumbent gap and gap/age histograms can alias burst persistence and alternating gaps. A four-by-four table of successive gap-bin pairs on three consecutive supported events preserves this serial information at fixed supplied history. A small residual reading it may improve validation ranking beyond equal-head margin-product and zero controls. This is a prospective, single-seed local hypothesis, not an established mechanism or novelty claim. Observed local evidence: baseline-static AUC0.6050036145, baseline-pooled0.6102261137 and baseline-din0.6133619861 establish useful history. g1-r0022-timing_joint AUC0.6306853561/Logloss0.1926808861 versus timing_marginal0.6304909229/0.1927344747 and timing_zero0.6304914120/0.1927189675 suggests a small single-seed timing-association effect. However timing_gap_only0.6299545007/0.1928655540 is worse, so adding a readout is not automatically helpful. Implementation inspection and scalar witnesses show an actual representational alias: the entire parent can map two same-coarse-age histories identically while consecutive-gap tables differ. This is information-retention evidence, not measured utility.

nearest_work.difference: Exact whole parent retained. Its gap-by-newer-endpoint-age counts do not explicitly encode adjacent-gap pairs. New deterministic 16-coordinate serial table uses three supported events, with marginal-product, symmetrized and zero replacements.

DIN describes candidate-aware weighted sum pooling and explicitly discusses a negative LSTM attempt; neither is a consecutive-gap contingency readout. The local baseline is field-adapted and normalized, whereas original DIN relaxes attention normalization. No exact reproduction or broad priority claim.
Only author README inspected: behavior has category, brand and type, no item. Preserve this information boundary. Full paper unavailable; no detailed DMR-mechanism or novelty comparison verified.

inherited_components: Exact complete g1-r0022-timing_joint model, shapes, parameter allocation order and scratch initialization; all parent forwards retained
Fixed supplied causal128-event prefixes, hashed category/brand fields, four actions and relative ages; no invented item identity
Exact complete-field/singleton-timestamp support, oldest-first compaction and inherited elapsed-gap thresholds >60, >3600, >86400 seconds
Fixed host full-data three-epoch training, seed42, optimizer/loss and scorer; all four new heads allocated identically after every parent draw
study.proposed_difference: Append bias-free16->16->1 ReLU residual (272 parameters), final weight zero. K[i,j] counts successive gaps g_i,g_j over supported triples. Every cell computes all alternatives: observed K; raw row(K)*column(K)/sum(K) using positive denominator; symmetric (K+transpose(K))/2; zero. Apply log1p/log(129) and flatten16 only after replacement. Inputs differ; trainable shape, initialization and computation match. Serial branch ignores target, action and positive identity values but retains parent support. Filtering can bridge excluded events; this is supported-subsequence adjacency. New representation distinction will be checked by same-parent-summary witnesses; distinct global novelty remains unverified.
predictions: Observed beats product and zero on full validation AUC if serial dependence is useful; secondary Logloss must be reported even if conflicting. A product gain alone supports extra readout of margins, not serial dependence.

Observed beats symmetric only if chronological direction beyond undirected gap co-occurrence matters; observed~symmetric>product supports undirected dependence, not direction. These are planned overlapping contrasts, not an orthogonal factorial.

Count sum equals max(n_singleton-2,0); independent dense-rank oracle agrees; product preserves raw row/column margins; symmetrization preserves total and row+column margins. Empty, <3-supported-event, fully-tied and missing-field histories produce zero serial input.

All positive category/brand renamings, action/target changes, input permutations, masked padding and common age shifts leave new counts unchanged. A same-age-bin witness preserves inherited features while changing serial dependence; a three-gap-type cycle and its reversal additionally preserves the symmetrized table.
Serial overhead is O(BL log L+B*16) with O(BL+B*16) working storage beyond inherited parent; measured host cost, memory and throughput determine affordability, not asymptotic estimates.
falsifiers: Observed no better than matched product/zero is lack of support for this implementation; do not equate that with universal mechanism refutation.
Observed no better than symmetric fails the direction-specific prediction even if undirected dependence helps.
Oracle, mass, margin or invariance failures invalidate the contrast pending correction; nonfinite logits/gradients or cap exhaustion are execution failures, not scientific negative evidence.

A gain only on adaptively inspected slices or one small single-seed delta is insufficient for repeated support. Same-head controls do not match feature norms after logarithm, so normalization/conditioning remains an alternative.
alternative_explanations: Feature norm, sparsity and conditioning change after log replacement even with raw margin preservation; product tables need not describe a realizable event sequence.
Additional readout, optimization coupling and adaptive validation selection can explain small improvements. Symmetric/product/zero contrasts restrict but do not eliminate these explanations.
Age bins may proxy user activity, truncation or selection from excluding tied/missing events. All branches retain the same parent and information; no raw-log adjacency claim.

Single seed42 and repeated validation reuse cannot establish significance. User-cluster uncertainty and new seeds require host-supported later assessment; no predictions or bootstrap interface available locally.
Operational snapshots have undocumented as-of dates; benchmark static assumption remains frozen. No production causal validity inferred.

Trajectory review includes negative branches: g1-r0000-behavior_within AUC0.6119128872 below baseline-din0.6133619861; g1-r0011-event_energy0.6197049287 below its parent g1-r0009-global_norm0.6200937865 (trajectory index); g1-r0020-direct_native0.6301357048 below direct_lifted0.6304316804. Chronological product0.6218837031 versus exchangeable product0.6215240127 is single-seed evidence consistent with order utility, not proof that consecutive elapsed gaps help. g1-r0017-gap_product0.6300019102 versus independent_product0.6299785627 is near null for that fine gap-association contrast, despite both outperforming an earlier parent; do not recycle a generic timing explanation as established. g1-r0021-packet_observed0.6304253972 versus singleton_observed0.6302729237 also offers only modest single-seed evidence for timestamp unit choice. All resolved trajectories succeeded operationally; their negative scientific outcomes are retained rather than called execution failures.

Latest slices are exploratory: timing_joint vs timing_zero AUC0.6313183147 vs0.6310947060 in history_gt64 (3026583 impressions,151372 positives,2875211 negatives), but0.5780708949 vs0.5841202297 in history_1_16 (41805,1444,40361), and0.5906130734 vs0.5975942177 in empty_history (8272,310,7962). Empty-history residual is zero, so outcome differences there reflect whole-model training trajectories. Do not infer local history mechanisms from those slices or fit new bins. Host reports its existing frozen slices only.

Parent sources and successful baseline receipts are the available reproducible starting point. Raw physical tables and causal-preprocessing code are not exported for a fresh audit; host-frozen identities/readiness checks are relied on, with no new acquisition or audit claim. No failed execution receipt or previous_runtime_error is present in this phase. Empty registry search results are missing source evidence, not scientific counterevidence.
